scripts.build: npm run build:terminal-core && npm run build:native && npm --workspace qe-react-editor-app run build
scripts.dev: npm run build:terminal-core && npm run build:native && npm --workspace qe-react-editor-app run dev --
scripts.dev:debug: npm run build:terminal-core && npm run build:native && npm --workspace qe-react-editor-app run dev:debug --
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace terminal-react-core run typecheck && npm --workspace qe-react-editor-app run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace qe-react-editor-app run test && node app/test/protocol-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm --workspace qe-react-editor-app run test:e2e
